info.name: SoFurry API Documentation
info.description: The SoFurry public API (v1) provides programmatic access to user data, submissions, content and site statistics.

item.name: Folders
item.description:
Manage your submission folders. Folders organise your own submissions into
named groups. Every endpoint operates on the authenticated user's folders.

request.description: Returns all folders belonging to the authenticated user.

Returns a single folder you own, with the hashids of the submissions it
contains.

Deletes the folder itself. The submissions inside are not deleted — they
are only removed from the folder.

item.name: Add a submission to a folder

request.description:
Both the folder and the submission must belong to you. Adding a submission
that is already in the folder is a no-op.

item.name: Remove a submission from a folder

request.description:
Returns the site-wide upload configuration: allowed MIME types, per-category type
lists and allowed extensions, max file sizes, and subscriber/adult flags.

This is the canonical source for the **category** and **type** enumerations used by
the submission endpoints. Each entry in `categorySettings` exposes the integer
`categoryId` and a `types` map of human label → integer type id. For reference, the
category ids are: `10` Artwork, `20` Writing, `30` Photography, `40` Music,
`50` Video, `60` 3D, `70` Game.

Two related enumerations are not returned here but are used by the submission
endpoints — `rating` (content level): `0` Clean, `10` Mature, `20` Adult; and
`privacy`: `1` Private, `2` Unlisted, `3` Public.

Returns rounded public counts for uploads, content items, users, comments, statuses and total content views.
All values are rounded to the nearest 50.

item.name: Submissions
item.description: Endpoints for creating, reading and updating submissions and their content.

request.description:
Creates a new empty draft submission owned by the authenticated user and returns it.
The draft has no title, category or content yet — use the **Update Submission** and
**Add File Content** / **Add Embed Content** endpoints to populate it, then set `privacy`
to `3` (Public) via Update Submission to publish.

Typical creation workflow:
1. `PUT /v1/submission` — create the draft, note the returned `id`
2. `POST /v1/submission/{id}/content` (file) or `/content/embed` — attach content
3. `POST /v1/submission/{id}` — set title, category, rating, tags and privacy

request.description:
Uploads a file and attaches it as a new content item on the given submission.
Use `multipart/form-data` encoding. The file extension determines the submission type
(image, story, music, etc.) if one has not been set yet.

Allowed extensions mirror the site upload settings — call **Get Uploader Settings** for the
current list.

request.description:
Returns a list of tag strings matching the given query prefix. Useful for auto-completing tag search fields.
Non-alphanumeric characters (except spaces and underscores) are stripped from the query.

variable.description: The user handle. Omit to return the authenticated user.

request.description:
Returns the public profile for the given user handle. When `handle` is omitted the endpoint returns
the currently authenticated user's profile, which includes additional private fields.
